answer: For FY2022, General Mills reported net income attributable to General Mills (parent) of $2,707.3 million ($2,707,300,000) and total cash dividends paid of $1,244.5 million ($1,244,500,000). The retention ratio (calculated as (Net Income Attributable to Shareholders - Dividends Paid) / Net Income Attributable to Shareholders) is 0.54 or 54.03%.
rationale: Net income attributable to General Mills is $2,707.3 million and total cash dividends paid is $1,244.5 million. Retention ratio = (2,707,300,000 - 1,244,500,000) / 2,707,300,000 = 0.5403169..., which rounds to 0.54 or 54.03%.
